extension.description: Capture and inspect HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC and WebSocket traffic from VS Code terminals and debug sessions.
view.traffic.title: Tapline Traffic
view.welcome:
Capture is stopped.
[Start Capture](command:tapline.start)
Terminals opened while capture runs are routed through Tapline automatically.
config.port: Loopback port for the capture proxy. Keep it different from the Tapline desktop app (6060) when both run.
config.autoStart: Start capture when VS Code opens.
config.terminal.inject: While capture runs, set HTTP(S)_PROXY and CA environment variables in new integrated terminals.
config.debug.inject: While capture runs, add proxy and CA environment variables to launched debug sessions.
config.debug.types: Debug configuration types that receive proxy environment variables.
config.ssl.enabled: Decrypt HTTPS for hosts matching tapline.ssl.hosts.
config.ssl.hosts: Host patterns whose TLS traffic is decrypted (wildcards allowed).
config.maxEntries: Maximum live transactions kept in memory.
config.groupByHost: Group the traffic view by host.
config.maxBodyKiB: Maximum request/response body bytes retained per direction, in KiB. Traffic is forwarded in full; larger bodies are marked truncated.
